pages.text: The $(item)greater anchor$() is built around a plain one, with shulker shells from the far cities. Whatever the plain anchor led to is $(thing)lost$() in the making.

pages.name: Greater Rift Gate
pages.text: Deepslate bricks. Amethyst on the top: corners and middle.

pages.title: What It Adds
pages.text: Its rift is three wide and three tall, and it gapes. More to the point, where it leads can be $(thing)changed$() whenever I like.$(br2)When it closes, it falls in on itself. When it opens again, the floor changes with it.

pages.title: Door to Door
pages.text: A gate can lead to another gate of mine instead of a room. Its floor grows grass if the far gate stands in the overworld, netherrack if it stands in the Nether.$(br2)It is one way. For the way back, the far gate must be set too.

pages.title: The Lightning
pages.text: It throws lightning from its frame into the tear. The lesser gate does too, less often. A switch on the gate quiets it.$(br2)I leave it on. It is the only weather I have.
